data.exact_reserve_text: The 2014 year of account declares a return on capacity of 15.3%. The following amounts are proposed to be transferred to member's personal reserve funds: 2014 Year of account 2,448.6.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net release of GBP 2.4486 million in prior year reserves for the 2016 financial year, primarily driven by a favourable closing of the 2014 year of account which declared a return on capacity of 15.3%. The 2015 year of account is currently forecast to close at a break-even position. No specific events or lines of business were detailed for this movement.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2014 year of account declares a return on capacity of 15.3%
